/VSYS.note: the servos run from the battery rail (3.6-6 V servos, agf_c04cls), not from 3.3 V; on USB it comes through the USB block's 1 A Schottky

layout.rules: servo plugs are wider than 0.1": Adafruit puts four side by side on 0.1" header ("you can only stack 4 next to each other", README); bulk capacitor next to the headers' power and ground rows

open_questions: Signal level: the RP2040 drives 3.3 V pulses; the C04CLS page gives no input threshold. Adafruit's board drives servos from the PCA9685 at its own supply; a 3.3 V pulse into a servo at 4.2 V is common but not confirmed for this servo.

Stall current: AGFRC gives none for the C04CLS. On battery the path is the DMG2305UX ("-4.2" A steady state, 25 °C); on USB the 1 A B5817WS ("IO Average Rectified Output Current 1") limits it: on USB, fins only for bench tests.
Frame rate: AGFRC lists "1520 µS / 333Hz"; whether 50 Hz frames also work is not stated. The RP2040's divider reaches ~7.5 Hz, so either is possible.
Capacitor height: 10 mm (8×10 case) stands highest on the board.
